source_text: De ultione quae in Madianitas facta est. Filii Israel fornicati sunt cum Madianitis; nunc Dominus: ulciscere ultionem.
pass_a_gloss: Concerning vengeance which against Midianites made was. Sons of-Israel fornicated with Midianites; now Lord: avenge vengeance.
pass_b_english: On [[vengeance against Midian >> Bible:Numbers 31]]: Israel fornicated with Midianite women; now the Lord says, Avenge the vengeance.
